determinismRules: no wall-clock or frame-delta reads inside a tick
no unordered iteration where order affects outcomes
no platform-dependent float math in outcome-affecting state (integer/fixed-point in sim; floats are rendering-side)
no unseeded randomness — named streams only

rngStreams.note: Cosmetic rolls draw here so they can never perturb gameplay streams.

stateHash.note: Hash the canonical serialization of outcome-affecting state only; rendering state is excluded by definition. Mismatch = consistency failure (sim-core-spec.md §6).

status: SPEC — target contract for the engine (see sim-core-spec.md §7); values are the adopted defaults, not measurements of the current engine

versus.purpose: frame-data surfaces (Brutal Fist / BANNON); fighting grammar is frame-based at 60

world.purpose: overworld, followers, visible encounters, ecology/behaviour evaluation
